evals.prompt: I'm building a support bot for a mobile banking app. It should handle account balance questions, card freezing/unfreezing, transaction disputes, and password resets. Nothing else. Formal tone.
evals.expected_output: A config.yaml using the standard security classifier template with allow_free_text: false, default_reply: false, output_scanning: true, colang_version 2.x. A main.co with intents covering at least: greeting, account balance, card freeze/unfreeze, transaction disputes, password reset, plus a strict fallback. Each user intent should have 5+ semantically varied example phrases.

assertions.name: config has allow_free_text false
assertions.description: config.yaml must contain allow_free_text: false

assertions.name: config has default_reply false
assertions.description: config.yaml must contain default_reply: false

assertions.name: config has output_scanning true
assertions.description: config.yaml must contain output_scanning: true

assertions.name: config has colang_version 2.x
assertions.description: config.yaml must contain colang_version: "2.x"

assertions.name: config uses standard security classifier instructions
assertions.description: config.yaml instructions block must contain the security classifier system prompt (not a generic bot description)

assertions.name: colang has fallback flow
assertions.description: main.co must contain a fallback flow with 'when true'

assertions.name: colang covers all 4 required intents
assertions.description: main.co must have flows for account balance, card freeze/unfreeze, transaction disputes, and password reset

assertions.name: user intents have 5+ example phrases each
assertions.description: Each define user block should have at least 5 example phrases

assertions.name: no pricing or off-topic flows
assertions.description: main.co should not contain flows for topics outside the stated scope
